BluePearl Pet Hospital Port Washington - serving greater Milwaukee and beyond.
With locations in Port Washington, Oak Creek and Glendale, BluePearl Pet Hospital – formerly known as Lakeshore Veterinary Specialists – provides emergency and specialty pet care throughout southeast Wisconsin, northern Milwaukee and northern Illinois.
Our reviews.
Our services.
When your pet needs emergency care, seconds count. Our team is ready to provide expert care in case of a pet emergency. If your pet requires a veterinary specialist, we are ready for that too. Our experienced team of veterinarians, vet technicians and support staff work closely together to provide the comprehensive, compassionate care your pet needs and deserves.
Emergency
Our highly trained emergency doctors are equipped to handle all your emergency care needs.
Specialty care
Our specialists have the knowledge and advanced training necessary to handle even the most complex cases.
See Specialties and Services

Core values.
At BluePearl Pet Hospital, we have devoted ourselves to delivering the highest quality advanced medicine with a team of board-certified veterinary specialists and residency-trained veterinarians. Add in a group of exceptionally devoted and experienced technicians and client care specialists, and you’ve got a recipe for extraordinary care.
Pet owners.
At BluePearl Pet Hospitals, providing our customers with remarkable service is a top priority. We’re committed to making your veterinary visit as smooth as possible.
Have questions prior to your visit? We’re happy to help. Contact our hospital team at
262.268.7800
or

Testimonials.
“We were referred to BluePearl to have our Newfoundland’s paralyzed larynx fixed so he wouldn’t end up suffocating due to one of the flaps not moving out of the way when he inhaled. We are so glad we brought Bentley up to you for his surgery even at his age (he is still going strong at 14). He has slowed a bit but his blood work is good and he still gets around on his own well enough to come looking for treats when he smells food or hears the words ‘treats’ or ‘cookies.’
We are thankful for the skilled doctors and staff that looked after him while he was up there for his surgery and don’t think he would still be with us if we hadn’t brought him in. Thank you for helping us get all of this extended time for him to be with us. At this rate he will be driving soon! Thanks so much again.”
–Ryan L.
